name: HZplan
original_description: HZplan turns floor-plan images or written dimensions into structured, editable home plans your assistant can reason about. Use AI as a practical design partner to test ideas before you move or buy anything: check whether furniture fits, compare layouts, see how a Scandinavian style changes your bedroom, or model how a new antique table will look in your living room. Your assistant can build and update the plan, furnish rooms, apply finishes and styles, and prepare 2D plans, 3D walkthroughs, and VR views so you can inspect the result and decide what works. If you are starting from scratch, generate a private demo plan to explore what is possible, learn how styles and 3D views work, and move quickly into designing your own home. HZplan supports exploration and decision-making; verify measurements and use qualified professionals for safety-critical or regulated work.
